question: Estimate the annual revenue of a successful Indian SaaS startup at ARR scale (~₹100 Cr ARR).
idealClarificationQuestions: Annual Recurring Revenue ~₹100 Cr Indian SaaS company? Yes.
Including non-recurring revenue (one-time fees, services)? Yes — total revenue.
